description: Estimate WHEN an order would arrive at an Australian postcode — the question behind 'can I get it by Friday?'. Works the timeline through honestly: production starts only after the customer approves their digital proof (3pm Melbourne time cut-off), then the QUANTITY-based production time (1–15 items → 1 working day, 16–40 → 2, 41–100 → 3, 101–200 → 4, 201+ → the team sets the date), then transit for their postcode (metro/regional/remote bands). Returns an arrival WINDOW plus the assumptions it made. This is an ESTIMATE, never a guarantee — always relay the caveat, and for a hard deadline tell them to call 1300 721 614. Free pickup from Derrimut VIC is usually the fastest option.

artwork_ready.description: true if artwork is print-ready and the proof will be approved immediately

product.description: product name — used to read its real production time

quantity.description: how many identical items — turnaround depends on it (default 1)

turnaround.description: quantity-aware ready-to-dispatch: { ready_to_dispatch, approve_by, working_days, basis: tier|provisional, sentence }
